copyPanel.formula: Surface Area = Base Area + Sum of Triangular Lateral Faces
steps: 1. Calculate area of base polygon (square, rectangle, or triangle)
2. Calculate area of each triangular face using ½ × base × slant height
3. Add the base area and all triangular face areas together

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: The Louvre Pyramid
revealWordProblem.text: The Louvre Pyramid in Paris is a square pyramid made of glass panels. How could you use a net and the surface area formula to find the total area of glass in its four triangular faces?
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: A photograph of the glass pyramid at the Louvre museum in Paris.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Unfold the pyramid into a net: the square base separates from the four triangular faces so each one lies flat and can be measured on its own. Since the question only asks about the glass in the four triangular faces, find the area of one triangular face using ½ × base edge × slant height, then multiply by 4 — the base square is not part of this total. For example, if the base edge is 6 ft and the slant height is 8 ft, one triangular face is ½ × 6 × 8 = 24 ft², so the four faces together need 4 × 24 = 96 ft² of glass.

questions.stem: A square pyramid has a base edge of 5 in and a slant height of 7 in. What is the surface area?
questions.explanation: Base: 5 × 5 = 25 in². Each lateral face: ½ × 5 × 7 = 17.5 in². Four faces: 4 × 17.5 = 70 in². SA = 25 + 70 = 95 in².
choiceFeedback: You calculated the four triangular faces but forgot to add the square base area.
Check the units — surface area is measured in square units, not cubic.
Recheck each triangular face area — make sure you take half of base times slant height for each.
hints: A square pyramid has TWO kinds of faces: one square base (5 × 5) and four identical triangles with slant height 7.
SA = base area + 4 triangle areas, where each triangle is ½ × base edge × slant height.
Base first: 5 × 5 = 25 in². Then one triangle: ½ × 5 × 7. Multiply that by 4 and add the base area.
questions.stemEs: Una pirámide cuadrada tiene una arista de base de 5 in y una altura inclinada de 7 in. ¿Cuál es el área de superficie?
questions.explanationEs: Base: 5 × 5 = 25 in². Cada cara lateral: ½ × 5 × 7 = 17.5 in². Cuatro caras: 4 × 17.5 = 70 in². Área de superficie = 25 + 70 = 95 in².
hintsEs: Una pirámide cuadrangular tiene DOS tipos de caras: una base cuadrada (5 × 5) y cuatro triángulos idénticos con apotema de 7.
AS = área de la base + 4 áreas de triángulo, donde cada triángulo es ½ × arista de la base × apotema.
La base primero: 5 × 5 = 25 pulg². Luego un triángulo: ½ × 5 × 7. Multiplica eso por 4 y súmale el área de la base.

questions.stem: How many lateral (triangular) faces does a square pyramid have?

The square base isn't a lateral (triangular) face — only count the slanted triangle sides.
That's too many — count only the slanted triangular sides around the square base.
hints: Lateral faces are the slanted triangles on the sides — the square base itself doesn't count.
Each side of the square base holds up exactly one triangle. Count the sides of a square.
Trace the base: it's a square. Count one triangle leaning against each side of that square.
questions.stemEs: ¿Cuántas caras laterales (triangulares) tiene una pirámide cuadrada?
questions.explanationEs: Una pirámide cuadrada tiene una base cuadrada y 4 caras laterales triangulares, una por cada lado del cuadrado.
hintsEs: Las caras laterales son los triángulos inclinados de los lados; la base cuadrada no cuenta.
Cada lado de la base cuadrada sostiene exactamente un triángulo. Cuenta los lados de un cuadrado.
Traza la base: es un cuadrado. Cuenta un triángulo apoyado en cada lado de ese cuadrado.

questions.stem: What is the area of one triangular face with base 8 in and slant height 6 in?
questions.explanation: Area of a triangle = ½ × base × height = ½ × 8 × 6 = 24 in².
choiceFeedback: Adding the base and height won't give area — multiply them first, then take half.
Check the units — a flat triangular face needs square units, not cubic.
Don't forget to take half — a triangle's area is half of base times height, not the full product.
hints: You have one triangle: base 8 in, slant height 6 in. Triangle area is not just base × height.
Use area = ½ × base × height — multiply the two numbers first, then take half.
Multiply 8 × 6 = 48 first. Then take half of that result.
questions.stemEs: ¿Cuál es el área de una cara triangular con base de 8 in y altura inclinada de 6 in?
questions.explanationEs: Área de un triángulo = ½ × base × altura = ½ × 8 × 6 = 24 in².
hintsEs: Tienes un triángulo: base 8 pulg, apotema 6 pulg. El área del triángulo no es solo base × altura.
Usa área = ½ × base × altura: multiplica primero los dos números y luego saca la mitad.
Multiplica 8 × 6 = 48 primero. Luego saca la mitad de ese resultado.

reviewHighlights.formula: Surface Area = Base Area + Sum of Triangular Lateral Faces
steps: 1. Calculate area of base polygon (square, rectangle, or triangle)
2. Calculate area of each triangular face using ½ × base × slant height
3. Add the base area and all triangular face areas together
reviewHighlights.watchOut: A common mistake in Surface Area of Pyramids is finding the four triangular lateral faces correctly (½ × base edge × slant height, times 4) and then stopping — forgetting to add the base area at the end. This leaves the total surface area too small by exactly the base's area. Before you submit, ask: 'Did I add the base area to the four lateral faces, or did I stop after the sides?'

level1.stem: A square pyramid has a base that is 2 in by 2 in. Its slant height is 5 in. Find its surface area.
level1.stemEs: Una pirámide cuadrada tiene una base de 2 pulg por 2 pulg. Su altura inclinada mide 5 pulg. Halla su área de superficie.
hints: Find the base. Then find the 4 triangle faces. Add them.
hintsEs: Halla la base. Luego halla las 4 caras triangulares. Súmalas.
level1.explanation: Find the area of the base: 2 × 2 = 4 Find the four triangle faces: 1/2 × 2 × 5 = 5; 4 × 5 = 20 Add the base and the faces: 4 + 20 = 24
level1.explanationEs: Halla el área de la base: 2 × 2 = 4 Halla las cuatro caras triangulares: 1/2 × 2 × 5 = 5; 4 × 5 = 20 Suma la base y las caras: 4 + 20 = 24

level1.stem: A square pyramid has a base that is 6 cm by 6 cm. Its slant height is 4 cm. Find its surface area.
level1.stemEs: Una pirámide cuadrada tiene una base de 6 cm por 6 cm. Su altura inclinada mide 4 cm. Halla su área de superficie.
hints: One triangle face is half of 6 × 4.
hintsEs: Una cara triangular es la mitad de 6 × 4.
level1.explanation: Find the area of the base: 6 × 6 = 36 Find the four triangle faces: 1/2 × 6 × 4 = 12; 4 × 12 = 48 Add the base and the faces: 36 + 48 = 84
level1.explanationEs: Halla el área de la base: 6 × 6 = 36 Halla las cuatro caras triangulares: 1/2 × 6 × 4 = 12; 4 × 12 = 48 Suma la base y las caras: 36 + 48 = 84

level1.stem: A square pyramid has a base that is 4 m by 4 m. Its slant height is 3 m. Find its surface area.
level1.stemEs: Una pirámide cuadrada tiene una base de 4 m por 4 m. Su altura inclinada mide 3 m. Halla su área de superficie.
hints: Base: 4 × 4. One face: half of 4 × 3. Then add the base and 4 faces.
hintsEs: Base: 4 × 4. Una cara: la mitad de 4 × 3. Luego suma la base y 4 caras.
level1.explanation: Find the area of the base: 4 × 4 = 16 Find the four triangle faces: 1/2 × 4 × 3 = 6; 4 × 6 = 24 Add the base and the faces: 16 + 24 = 40
level1.explanationEs: Halla el área de la base: 4 × 4 = 16 Halla las cuatro caras triangulares: 1/2 × 4 × 3 = 6; 4 × 6 = 24 Suma la base y las caras: 16 + 24 = 40

level1.stem: A square pyramid has a base that is 2 in by 2 in. Its slant height is 4 in. Find its surface area.
level1.stemEs: Una pirámide cuadrada tiene una base de 2 pulg por 2 pulg. Su altura inclinada mide 4 pulg. Halla su área de superficie.
hints: Find the base. Then find one triangle face and multiply by 4.
hintsEs: Halla la base. Luego halla una cara triangular y multiplica por 4.
level1.explanation: Find the area of the base: 2 × 2 = 4 Find the four triangle faces: 1/2 × 2 × 4 = 4; 4 × 4 = 16 Add the base and the faces: 4 + 16 = 20
level1.explanationEs: Halla el área de la base: 2 × 2 = 4 Halla las cuatro caras triangulares: 1/2 × 2 × 4 = 4; 4 × 4 = 16 Suma la base y las caras: 4 + 16 = 20

level1.stem: A square pyramid has a base that is 10 ft by 10 ft. Its slant height is 13 ft. Find its surface area.
level1.stemEs: Una pirámide cuadrada tiene una base de 10 pies por 10 pies. Su altura inclinada mide 13 pies. Halla su área de superficie.
hints: Each triangle face has a base of 10 ft and a height of 13 ft.
hintsEs: Cada cara triangular tiene una base de 10 pies y una altura de 13 pies.
level1.explanation: Find the area of the base: 10 × 10 = 100 Find the four triangle faces: 1/2 × 10 × 13 = 65; 4 × 65 = 260 Add the base and the faces: 100 + 260 = 360
level1.explanationEs: Halla el área de la base: 10 × 10 = 100 Halla las cuatro caras triangulares: 1/2 × 10 × 13 = 65; 4 × 65 = 260 Suma la base y las caras: 100 + 260 = 360

level2.stem: A square pyramid has a base edge of 8 in and a slant height of 6 in. Ty writes 4 × (8 × 6) + 64 = 256. What is the correct surface area?
level2.stemEs: Una pirámide cuadrada tiene una arista de base de 8 pulg y una altura inclinada de 6 pulg. Ty escribe 4 × (8 × 6) + 64 = 256. ¿Cuál es el área de superficie correcta?
hints: Check how Ty found each triangle face. What is the area of a triangle?
hintsEs: Revisa cómo halló Ty cada cara triangular. ¿Cuál es el área de un triángulo?
level2.explanation: Find one triangle face. Use the 1/2: 1/2 × 8 × 6 = 24 Find the four faces: 4 × 24 = 96 Add the base: 96 + 64 = 160
level2.explanationEs: Halla una cara triangular. Usa el 1/2: 1/2 × 8 × 6 = 24 Halla las cuatro caras: 4 × 24 = 96 Suma la base: 96 + 64 = 160

level2.stem: A square pyramid has a base edge of 2.5 m. Its slant height is 4 m. Find its surface area.
level2.stemEs: Una pirámide cuadrada tiene una arista de base de 2.5 m. Su altura inclinada mide 4 m. Halla su área de superficie.
hints: A decimal edge does not change the steps: base, then 4 faces, then add.
hintsEs: Una arista decimal no cambia los pasos: la base, luego 4 caras, luego suma.
level2.explanation: Find the area of the base: 2.5 × 2.5 = 6.25 Find the four triangle faces: 1/2 × 2.5 × 4 = 5; 4 × 5 = 20 Add the base and the faces: 6.25 + 20 = 26.25
level2.explanationEs: Halla el área de la base: 2.5 × 2.5 = 6.25 Halla las cuatro caras triangulares: 1/2 × 2.5 × 4 = 5; 4 × 5 = 20 Suma la base y las caras: 6.25 + 20 = 26.25

level2.stem: A square pyramid has a base that is 12 cm by 12 cm. Its slant height is 10 cm. Find its surface area.
level2.stemEs: Una pirámide cuadrada tiene una base de 12 cm por 12 cm. Su altura inclinada mide 10 cm. Halla su área de superficie.
hints: Find the base area. Then add the 4 triangle faces.
hintsEs: Halla el área de la base. Luego suma las 4 caras triangulares.
level2.explanation: Find the area of the base: 12 × 12 = 144 Find the four triangle faces: 1/2 × 12 × 10 = 60; 4 × 60 = 240 Add the base and the faces: 144 + 240 = 384
level2.explanationEs: Halla el área de la base: 12 × 12 = 144 Halla las cuatro caras triangulares: 1/2 × 12 × 10 = 60; 4 × 60 = 240 Suma la base y las caras: 144 + 240 = 384

level2.stem: A square pyramid has a slant height of 10 in. Its 4 triangle faces have a total area of 240 square inches. How long is each base edge?
level2.stemEs: Una pirámide cuadrada tiene una altura inclinada de 10 pulg. Sus 4 caras triangulares tienen un área total de 240 pulgadas cuadradas. ¿Cuánto mide cada arista de la base?
hints: Find one face first. Then undo the half and divide by the slant height.
hintsEs: Primero halla una cara. Luego deshaz la mitad y divide entre la altura inclinada.
level2.explanation: Find one triangle face: 240 ÷ 4 = 60 Undo the half: 60 × 2 = 120 Divide by the slant height: 120 ÷ 10 = 12
level2.explanationEs: Halla una cara triangular: 240 ÷ 4 = 60 Deshaz la mitad: 60 × 2 = 120 Divide entre la altura inclinada: 120 ÷ 10 = 12

level2.stem: A gift box is a square pyramid. Its base is 7 in by 7 in. Its slant height is 9 in. How much paper covers every face?
level2.stemEs: Una caja de regalo es una pirámide cuadrada. Su base mide 7 pulg por 7 pulg. Su altura inclinada mide 9 pulg. ¿Cuánto papel cubre todas las caras?
hints: Every face means the square base and the 4 triangle faces.
hintsEs: Todas las caras quiere decir la base cuadrada y las 4 caras triangulares.
level2.explanation: Find the area of the base: 7 × 7 = 49 Find the four triangle faces: 1/2 × 7 × 9 = 31.5; 4 × 31.5 = 126 Add the base and the faces: 49 + 126 = 175
level2.explanationEs: Halla el área de la base: 7 × 7 = 49 Halla las cuatro caras triangulares: 1/2 × 7 × 9 = 31.5; 4 × 31.5 = 126 Suma la base y las caras: 49 + 126 = 175

level3.stem: A square pyramid has a base measuring 6 m by 6 m and four triangular faces, each with a base of 6 m and a slant height of 5 m. What is its surface area?
choiceFeedback: That is the square base alone. Add the four triangular faces.
That is the four triangles alone. Add the 6 by 6 base.
The triangles were never halved: four times 6 times 5 is 120 rather than 60. A triangle is half of base times height.
level3.explanation: Base area = 6 × 6 = 36. Each triangle = ½ × 6 × 5 = 15, and 4 × 15 = 60. Total = 36 + 60 = 96 square meters.

level3.stem: A square pyramid has a base edge of 18 cm, a height of 12 cm and a slant height of 15 cm. Lee uses 12 cm for the triangle faces and gets 756. Find the correct surface area.
level3.stemEs: Una pirámide cuadrada tiene una arista de base de 18 cm, una altura de 12 cm y una altura inclinada de 15 cm. Lee usa 12 cm para las caras triangulares y obtiene 756. Halla el área de superficie correcta.
hints: Which height runs along a triangle face?
hintsEs: ¿Qué altura va sobre una cara triangular?
level3.explanation: Find the base: 18 × 18 = 324 Use the slant height for the faces: 1/2 × 18 × 15 = 135; 4 × 135 = 540 Add: 324 + 540 = 864
level3.explanationEs: Halla la base: 18 × 18 = 324 Usa la altura inclinada para las caras: 1/2 × 18 × 15 = 135; 4 × 135 = 540 Suma: 324 + 540 = 864

level3.stem: A square pyramid has a base edge of 14 in. Its height is 24 in. Its slant height is 25 in. Find its surface area.
level3.stemEs: Una pirámide cuadrada tiene una arista de base de 14 pulg. Su altura es 24 pulg. Su altura inclinada es 25 pulg. Halla su área de superficie.
hints: Only one of the two heights belongs on a triangle face.
hintsEs: Solo una de las dos alturas va sobre una cara triangular.
level3.explanation: Find the area of the base: 14 × 14 = 196 Find the four triangle faces: 1/2 × 14 × 25 = 175; 4 × 175 = 700 Add the base and the faces: 196 + 700 = 896
level3.explanationEs: Halla el área de la base: 14 × 14 = 196 Halla las cuatro caras triangulares: 1/2 × 14 × 25 = 175; 4 × 175 = 700 Suma la base y las caras: 196 + 700 = 896

level3.stem: A gift box is a square pyramid with a 10 cm base edge. It takes 400 square centimeters of paper to cover every face. What is its slant height?
level3.stemEs: Una caja de regalo es una pirámide cuadrada con una arista de base de 10 cm. Se necesitan 400 centímetros cuadrados de papel para cubrir todas las caras. ¿Cuál es su altura inclinada?
hints: Take away the base first. Then find one face.
hintsEs: Primero quita la base. Luego halla una cara.
level3.explanation: Take away the base: 400 − 10 × 10 = 300 Find one triangle face: 300 ÷ 4 = 75 Find the slant height: 75 × 2 = 150; 150 ÷ 10 = 15
level3.explanationEs: Quita la base: 400 − 10 × 10 = 300 Halla una cara triangular: 300 ÷ 4 = 75 Halla la altura inclinada: 75 × 2 = 150; 150 ÷ 10 = 15

level3.stem: A cube has edges of 6 in. A square pyramid has a 6 in base edge. Both have the same surface area. What is the pyramid's slant height?
level3.stemEs: Un cubo tiene aristas de 6 pulg. Una pirámide cuadrada tiene una arista de base de 6 pulg. Los dos tienen la misma área de superficie. ¿Cuál es la altura inclinada de la pirámide?
hints: Find the cube's surface area. Then work backward for the pyramid.
hintsEs: Halla el área de superficie del cubo. Luego trabaja hacia atrás con la pirámide.
level3.explanation: Find the cube's surface area: 6 × (6 × 6) = 216 Take away the pyramid's base: 216 − 36 = 180 Find one face, then the slant height: 180 ÷ 4 = 45; 45 × 2 ÷ 6 = 15
level3.explanationEs: Halla el área de superficie del cubo: 6 × (6 × 6) = 216 Quita la base de la pirámide: 216 − 36 = 180 Halla una cara y luego la altura inclinada: 180 ÷ 4 = 45; 45 × 2 ÷ 6 = 15
